item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Site Recovery Support for Azure ARC-enabled Windows VMWare/Physical servers
item.description:
Azure Site Recovery now supports disaster recovery for Azure Arc-enabled Windows VMware virtual machines and on-premises physical servers. This lets customers protect Arc-managed machines with ASR while still using Azure Arc for governance and inventory.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: BYON (Bring Your Own NIC) in Azure Site Recovery
item.description:
Azure Site Recovery now supports Bring Your Own NIC (BYON) for Azure-to-Azure test failover and failover, allowing you to attach an existing pre-provisioned NIC in the target region. This can preserve existing network configurations and reserved IP settings.

  • Source: Azure Updates
